item.title: Network & K8s.06-1 VPC Addresses, EKS Pods
item.description: Read an EKS cluster from the VPC up: how route tables decide public and private subnets, where security groups and network ACLs apply, how the VPC CNI hands subnet addresses to Pods through ENIs and why that caps Pod density, and how the AWS Load Balancer Controller turns Ingress and Service objects into ALBs and NLBs with instance or IP targets.
